auxiliary_data: Only other-assay official train labels in development, train+valid in final. Target assay is absent. This is conditional-assay evaluation, not structure-only generalization.
selection: Use folds0/1 to freeze method; frozen method confirmed on fold2 and official valid. Same-fit-row structure tree is a reproducible control. Historical proxy identity differs from v73 and is supplemental only.
acceptance: Positive gain versus structure tree on both selection folds and both confirmation parts; MAE mean relative improvement >=0.01 or rank mean absolute improvement >=0.003 in each stage. Fixed 0.75 anchor blend must improve historical proxy on both confirmation parts and have positive mean on selection parts. No retuning from confirmation results.
limitations: All development labels reused historically. Historical proxy is not exact same-fold full v73 OOF. Local gains do not prove platform gains; aggregation formula unknown.
